newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Sales of all top pharma products up-Roche.
newsitem.headline: Sales of all top pharma products up-Roche.

text.p: Roche Holding AG said volume gains were recorded for all its pharmaceuticals division's top selling products and new products were very well received in the market during the first nine months of 1996.
Roche reported a 12 percent rise in pharmaceuticals sales to 7.638 billion Swiss francs for the nine month period.

In its vitamins and fine chemicals division, demand was particularly buoyant for astaxanthin, B-complex vitamins, citric acid and antioxidants vitamin E, beta-carotene and vitamin C, Roche also said. It said demand was especially strong in Europe and the Americas.

Roche's diagnostics division posted a 16 percent sales gain to 540 million francs and the company said prime growth factors were a good market reception of its new analytical systems, growth in the immunochemistry segment and its growing Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) business.
The group also said fragrance segment sales growth in the United States, the Asia-Pacific region and South America compensated for sluggish demand in Europe.
But declining flavour sales in the U.S. and Japan were not entirely offset by good sales in the Asia-Pacific region and in South America.
"Fragrance chemicals continue to be exposed to volume and pricing pressures owing to weak economic growth," Roche said in a statement. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
